title: 第1279章 仙胎魔像第1278章 以法破法
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
尽管知晓答案，李元还是再问了一遍。
令他意外的是，白眉矢口否认。
“晏巡天之死，是他的宿命，晏巡天是死于他的良善，非我之过，我之恶尸非我，是天地规律所成，他要杀我恶念，败了自要承担苦果。”
“你的恶念不是你？这是什么歪理。”李元冷道。
“人生来便有三尸相伴，善尸恶尸本我尸，是天地大道的自然规则，若论过错，需先问天地之过，我何错之有？”
白眉反驳。
从始至终，他都认为这是天地之错，三尸不除，如何证道永恒？
他走上这条路，是天道的指引。
“恶尸是你造，那就是你。”
好友已死，李元可不想论大道至理。
白眉淡漠道：“依你之言，你和晏巡天先杀了善尸洛净生，恶尸再杀晏巡天，是否属于因果相报？”
李元嗤笑，“三尸出于一体，你敢说你什么都没做吗？若你问心无愧，岂会出现于此，与我为敌？”
“我是一个商人，所行皆为逐利，我助力推广初圣法典，只为仙殿盈利，未曾主动残害众生。”白眉平静说着，“关于初圣法典，洛净生说的很对，害死世人的从来都不是一本法典，而是人性的丑陋，是与生俱来的阶级差距，是弱肉强食的修行至理。”
“至于为什么会出现于此，与你为敌，是因为我了解你。”
“仇恨的种子已经在你心中种下，你会将一切归责于我，你若赢了至尊仙胎，我亦难逃一劫。”
“你说的很对，杀了至尊仙胎，我立即就杀你。”李元毫不避讳，张狂回应。
白眉笑了，“所以…真正不讲理的人是你。”
“歪理正理，邪魔道理，本来就说不通。”
李元释放蛞蝓，无数蛊虫探向魔渊深处的虚空，想要趁势找出白眉的位置。
“你找不到的。”白眉轻叹。

“白眉，和他废什么话，世间哪有那么多相互理解，这个世界本就该强者为尊！”
至尊仙胎大喝出声，打断了两人交流。
“是啊。”白眉的声音更加深沉了，“世间一切都围绕利益转动，或许永恒也只是一场的利益的交换，若人人有此觉悟，何来纷争。”
“李元，最后给你一个交易的机会。”
“只要你答应往后不再对我出手，你我恩怨就此一笔勾销，那恶尸我替你杀。”
“滚！”李元懒得交谈。
三尸本就要除，白眉这是想两面通吃。
至尊仙胎都讥笑，“白眉，和李元做生意你赚过吗？”
“唉，的确是亏了。”
白眉的气息褪去。
与此同时，魔渊大阵彻底启动了。
此阵是白眉以缥缈虚无镜推演，融合了至尊仙胎的大道经文，植入魔渊的骨干之中生成。
阵启，魔渊中的生灵瞬息就被焚灭九成，化作了大阵的养料。
一些强大的魔道生灵也没有逃掉，被无形的锁链困住，被一点点吸干，以维持魔渊大阵的运转。
“即使本尊已如此强大，但本尊还是为你准备了很多，李元，能死于本尊之手，是你的荣幸。”
至尊仙胎与魔渊大阵相合。
轰隆隆！
以其为核心，大量的血色光柱冲天而起，将魔渊彻底染成了血红色。
无数光柱在半空中交汇、融合，渐渐凝聚成一个巨大轮廓。
那是一尊魔像，通体由血色大道本源构成，高可触及寰宇，身披星河，头生双角，背后张开六对狰狞的骨翼。它的面容模糊不清，唯有一双金色的眼眸格外醒目，散发着冰冷而威严的光芒。
content_en:
Although he knew the answer, Li Yuan asked again.
To his surprise, Bai Mei denied it.
"Yan Xuntian's death was his fate. Yan Xuntian died because of his kindness. It is not my fault. My evil corpse is not mine. It is caused by the laws of heaven and earth. He wanted to kill me because of his evil thoughts. If he fails, he will have to bear the consequences."
"Your evil thoughts are not yours? What kind of fallacy is this?" Li Yuan coldly said.
"Everyone is born with three corpses. The good corpse, the evil corpse, and my own corpse are the natural rules of heaven and earth. If we talk about faults, we need to first ask the fault of heaven and earth. Why am I wrong?"
Bai Mei retorted.
From the beginning to the end, he believed that this was the fault of heaven and earth. If the three corpses were not removed, how could he prove eternity?
He embarked on this path because of the guidance of heaven.
"You created the evil corpse, that's you."
His friend is dead, and Li Yuan doesn't want to talk about the truth.
Bai Mei said indifferently: "According to your words, you and Yan Xuntian killed the good corpse Luo Jingsheng first, and then the evil corpse killed Yan Xuntian. Is this considered retribution?"
Li Yuan sneered, "Three corpses come from one body. Do you dare to say that you didn't do anything? If you had a clear conscience, how could you show up here and be my enemy?"
"I am a businessman, and everything I do is driven by profit. I help promote the First Saint Code, only for the profit of the Immortal Palace, and have never actively harmed any living beings." Bai Mei said calmly, "About the First Saint Code, Luo Jingsheng is right. It is never a code that kills people in the world, but the ugliness of human nature, the inherent class gap, and the practice of the law of the jungle."
"As for why I appear here and become your enemy, it's because I know you."
"The seeds of hatred have been planted in your heart. You will blame everything on me. If you win the Supreme Immortal Fetus, I will not be able to escape."
"You are right. If you kill the Supreme Immortal Fetus, I will kill you immediately." Li Yuan responded arrogantly without any hesitation.
Bai Mei smiled, "So... the really unreasonable person is you."
"Wrong truths, evil truths, and devilish truths don't make sense in the first place."
Li Yuan released the slugs, and countless gu worms explored the void deep in the Demonic Abyss, hoping to take advantage of the situation to find Bai Mei's location.
"You can't find it." Bai Mei sighed.
"Bai Mei, what nonsense are you talking to him? There is not so much mutual understanding in the world. The strong should be respected in this world!"
The Supreme Immortal Fetus shouted loudly, interrupting the exchange between the two.
"Yes." Bai Mei's voice became deeper, "Everything in the world revolves around interests. Perhaps eternity is just an exchange of interests. If everyone has this awareness, there will be no disputes."
"Li Yuan, I will finally give you a chance to trade."
"As long as you promise not to do anything to me in the future, the grudge between you and me will be wiped out, and I will kill that evil corpse for you."
"Get out!" Li Yuan was too lazy to talk.
The three corpses were meant to be eliminated, but Baimei wanted to take advantage of both sides.
The Supreme Immortal Fetus all sneered, "Bai Mei, have you ever made any money doing business with Li Yuan?"
"Oh, it's indeed a loss."
The breath of white eyebrows faded away.
At the same time, the Demonic Abyss Formation was completely activated.
This formation was deduced by Bai Mei using the ethereal mirror, fused with the Tao scriptures of the Supreme Immortal Fetus, and implanted into the backbone of the Demonic Abyss.
When the formation started, 90% of the creatures in the Demonic Abyss were instantly incinerated and turned into nourishment for the formation.
Some powerful demonic beings did not escape. They were trapped by invisible chains and sucked dry little by little to maintain the operation of the Demonic Abyss Formation.
"Even though I am so powerful, I have still prepared a lot for you. Li Yuan, it is your honor to die at my hands."
The Supreme Immortal Fetus and the Demonic Abyss Formation are combined.
Boom!
With it as its core, a large number of bloody light pillars rose into the sky, completely dyeing the Demonic Abyss blood red.
Countless light beams met and merged in mid-air, gradually condensing into a huge outline.
It was a demonic statue whose entire body was made of the blood-colored Dao Origin. It could reach the height of the universe. It was covered with stars, had two horns on its head, and six pairs of ferocious bone wings spread out from its back. Its face is blurry, only a pair of goldenThe eyes are particularly eye-catching, exuding a cold and majestic light.
